comment: A design for tools/ui-scripts/patch-opening.mitcad-ui (mitcad#1927): a 20 x 10 x 5 box, Body1 (F1.b0), whose top face Unstitch1 (F2) takes out into a surface body of its own (F2.b0), which RemoveBody1 (F3) deletes: Body1 is left an open shell of five faces with one opening along the four walls' top edges. All geometry is synthetic.
